buffs.details: Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.

buffs.name: Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
buffs.details: Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.

buffs.name: Algorithm Compaction
buffs.details: After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 stacks of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.

buffs.name: Inherent Skil: Ghost Cyberware
buffs.details:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 stack of Optical Illusion. Max 1 stack by default.
Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 stack of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 time every 0.5s.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Function Cracking
buffs.details:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

Network Backdoor
Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream
resonanceChains.details:
Lucy is now immune to interruptions during Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Inteference, Heavy Attack - Dual Threading, and Heavy Attack - Multi-Threading
Casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination increases ATK by 20% for 14s.
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target affected by Spoofing Program with direct damage, Lucy records the effect triggered and activates the corresponding Quick Action on that Resonator for 6s. The record expires when Lucy is knocked out.
Quick Action: When activated, inflict the recorded Spoofing Program effects on targets within a certain distance from the active Resonator in the team, effective once only on each target.
The following Spoofing Program effects can be recorded: Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction, Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol, Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement, Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch, and Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis. When applying Spoofing Program effects via Quick Action, only the continuous status effects are applied.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: The Blackwall, the Past, the Escape
resonanceChains.details:
While casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner and Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, Lucy's starting RAM is increased to 32.
After casting Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, deal 1 additional instance of Spectro DMG equal to 450% of Lucy's ATK, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When this instance of damage hits the target, apply all of the following Spoofing Program effects: Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction,
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol, Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement, Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch, and Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis. Only the continuous status effects are applied.
Forte Circuit - Depths of Blackwall is enhanced: When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, the DMG Multiplier increase is raised from 270% to 560%.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: Cyberpunk
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multiplier of Override from Resonance Liberation - Netrunner and Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is increased by 50%, and its Crit. DMG is increased by 100%.
The DMG Multiplier of Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement is increased by 65%.
The DMG Multiplier of Hack Response - Data Crash is increased by 65%.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 4: No Living Legends in Night City
resonanceChains.details: When Resonators in the team inflict Hack - Shifting, Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 5: A Broken Path to Hell
resonanceChains.details:
The stack limit of Optical Illusion obtainable via Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware is increased to 2.
Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware is now enhanced: When Lucy's HP falls below 50%, she immediately gains 1 stack of Optical Illusion upon being hit. This effect has a Cooldown of 180s. When Optical Illusion is triggered, Lucy gains a Shield equal to 150% of ATK for 10s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: I Really Want to Stay At Your House
resonanceChains.details:
Targets with Hack - Shifting or in the Hack - Interfered state take 40% increased Heavy Attack DMG from Lucy.
Targets with Hack - Shifting or in the Hack - Interfered state take 60% increased Hack DMG from Lucy.
The Stagnation triggered by Hack Response - Data Crash now lasts for 1.5s.

weaponPassives.details: ATK is increased by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%

Inflicting Glacio Chafe on the target increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 24%/30%/36%/42%/48% for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

basicAttacks.name: Normal Attack: Snapshot
basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting Basic Attack Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to deploy Focus Ring. A cursor will move around the Focus Ring.
- Releasing the Normal Attack button when the cursor falls outside of Perfect Focus will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Trace.
- Releasing the Normal Attack button when the cursor falls within Perfect Focus will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring additional Trace.
Pressing Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack Stage 2 will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable instead of deploying Focus Ring.
When Focus Ring is deployed, the Perfect Focus zone continues to fill the ring. Once Focus Ring is completely filled, it automatically collapses and triggers Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, and 3 in sequence, and deploy Focus Ring during Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG. Shortly after performing this attack, press Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Phantom Frame
skillAttacks.description:
Pull in nearby targets, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting this skill, hold Resonance Skill to deploy Focus Ring. A cursor will move around the Focus Ring.
- Releasing the Resonance Skill button when the cursor falls outside of Perfect Focus will trigger Compensate, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Trace.
- Releasing the Resonance Skill button when the cursor falls within Perfect Focus will trigger Spotlight, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring additional Trace.
If Lucilla casts the skill on-field without holding Resonance Skill, she directly casts Compensate instead of deploying Focus Ring.

Compensate
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and reducing the Cooldown of Lucilla's Resonance Skill by 8s.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Spotlight
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting Spotlight, Lucilla additionally restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, and inflicts 1 extra stack of Glacio Chafe onto the target if she is in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe.
Spotlight is immune to interruptions. Switching to another Resonator while casting Spotlight ends the skill early.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Clear As Day
liberationAttacks.description:
Lucilla's holds up to 0 Resonance Energy. Clear As Day consumes no Resonance Energy.
Clear As Day unlocks when Lucilla holds all 3 Photos.

Clear As Day
Deal Glacio DMG and enter Reminiscence:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, the DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 10s.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, the DMG dealt is considered Echo Skill DMG. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 10s.
When in Reminiscence, Lucilla's resistance to interruption is increased, and she cannot cast Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation. Her Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Mid-air Attack, and Intro Skill - Clip It are replaced with Basic Attack - Tracing Forms, Dodge Counter - Reminiscence, Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence, and Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut respectively.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

Basic Attack - Tracing Forms
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 1, 2, & 3 consecutively.
While casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, consecutively press or hold Normal Attack to continuously attack the target.
While casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, release the Normal Attack button or finish the whole Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3 to automatically perform Letting It Go.

Letting It Go
Deal Glacio DMG to targets within the range. When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG/Echo Skill DMG.
Lucilla is immune to interruption and damage during Letting It Go, and Resonator switching is disabled while casting.
While casting Letting It Go, Lucilla additionally restores 20 points of Concerto Energy.
Casting Letting It Go ends Reminiscence.

Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Reminiscence
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Memory Palace
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Déjà Vu
While casting Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, gain 4 stacks of Film Roll for 30s, stacking up 4 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, gain 1 stack of Zoom for 30s, stacking up 1 time. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
The above effects end early when Lucilla switches Resonance Mode.

Film Roll
When an active Resonator in the team other than Lucilla inflicts Glacio Chafe onto the target, Lucilla consumes 1 stack of Film Roll to inflict Glacio Chafe 2 time on nearby targets. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

Zoom
Each stack of Zoom increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by 10%.

Oblivion
During Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, Lucilla consumes 1 Photo intermittently to perform Oblivion, dealing 1 instance of Glacio DMG:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, this instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG. The skill inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on the target.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, this instance of DMG is considered Echo Skill DMG. Each cast of Oblivion is considered as casting a different Echo Skill.

Quick Glance
Press Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, environmental collectibles, and special collectibles within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. Press the shutter button to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.

Trace
Lucilla can hold up to 150 points of Trace.
Restore 100 points of Trace while casting Intro Skill - Clip It.
Restore 50 points of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight.
Restore 50 points of Trace while casting Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Restore 25 points of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Compensate or Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable.

Photos
Lucilla can hold up to 3 Photos.
Every 50 points of Trace restored generates 1 Photo.

introAttacks.description:

This effect ends when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

When in Resonance Mode - Echo, grant 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator for 14s.
This effect ends when the incoming Resonator is switched off the field or when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

buffs.details:
When Focus Ring is deployed, Lucilla slows targets within her shot.
While casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio RES of targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is reduced by 8% for 30s. If an enemy falls to Glacio Chafe DMG during this time, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: Distant Noon
resonanceChains.details:

resonanceChains.details:

basicAttacks.name: Normal Attack: Mix-'n'-Match
basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack - Huntress
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Huntress
Hold Normal Attack to continuously fire at enemies at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Hold and then release Normal Attack while Rebecca is not casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress to cast Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
Deal Electro DMG.

Comin' in Hot! - Huntress
Somersault in mid-air and land.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Huntress
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Huntress
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Huntress
Press Dodge to attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
- Casting Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Basic Attack - Guts
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts does not reset Basic Attack - Huntress's attack cycle within a certain time.

Heavy Attack - Guts
Consume STA and attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Guts
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Guts
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Guts
Press Dodge and attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Guts.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Guts.

attacks.label: Tactical Dodge - Huntress Successful Dodge DMG
Tactical Dodge - Guts Successful Dodge DMG

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Tactical Tweaks
skillAttacks.description:
Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!
Press Resonance Skill when in the Huntress mode to close the distance and spray lead at enemies, then switch to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!
Press Resonance Skill when in the Guts mode to spray lead at the enemy, then use recoil from shooting the ground to close the distance and switch to Huntress mode to continue the barrage, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

attacks.label: Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time! DMG
Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! DMG

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Party 'til Dawn!
liberationAttacks.description:
Switching to Mk. 31 HMG mode generates a field of Stagnation for 9.5s, in which:
Rebecca fires the Mk. 31 HMG automatically, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating Overload. Press or hold Normal Attack or press Resonance Liberation at intervals after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her Mk. 31 HMG's firepower and accumulate Overload faster. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times.
- The machine gun will only auto-lock onto the enemy closest to the crosshair in the aim down sight.
- Rebecca is immobile when firing the Mk. 31 HMG and gains 50% DMG Reduction and Immunity to Interrruption.

Overload
Rebecca can hold up to 90 points of Overload.
Hitting targets with the standard firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 2 points.
Hitting targets with the enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 4 points.
Hitting targets with the twice-enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 6 points.

BOOM! Fireworks!
After Mk. 31 HMG mode ends or when Overload is maxed, BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically cast, dealing Electro DMG. Casting BOOM! Fireworks! ends Mk. 31 HMG.
- Hold Resonance Liberation while in Mk. 31 HMG mode to immediatly cast BOOM! Fireworks!.
- Leaving the Mk. 31 HMG mode removes all Overload.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Gloves Are Comin' Off!
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Switch Gears!
Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes.
- The Huntress mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%.
- The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the Huntress mode.

Hack - Shifting
Rebecca inflicts Hack - Shifting upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

Hack Response - Meltdown
Deal Electro DMG to all targets affected by Hack - Interfered within the range, considered Hack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Huntress is replaced with Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
During Heavy Attack - Huntress, if Fervor is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of Tactical Dodge - Huntress, release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Fervor
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Fervor.
Normal Attacks restore Fervor upon damaging the target.
Resonance Skill restores Fervor upon damaging the target.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is gained by casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca restores 50 points of Fervor.

Hot Hand
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Hot Hand.
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 points per second.
Casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts restores 40 points.

A Girl Gets What She Wants!
At 120 points of Hot Hand, casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!, or Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! grants the following effects for 12s:
Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the Huntress and Guts modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
Hot Hand cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by 10 points per second.

introAttacks.name: Intro Skill: My Turn!
introAttacks.description:
Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!
When in the Huntress mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy and sprays lead with Huntress, then switches to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!
When in the Guts mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil of Guts from shooting the ground and switches to the Huntress mode to spray lead at the enemy, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

attacks.label: Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! DMG
Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me! DMG

outroAttacks.name: Outro Skill: Preem Choom
outroAttacks.description:
Summon a turret that continuously attacks enemies for 14s, dealing 2.5% Electro DMG each hit.
The incoming Resonator gains Edgerunner Bonds, granting 15% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Resonators with Edgerunner Bonds gain 1 stack of Overlimit every 0.2s, each stack granting 0.5% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification, up to 35% (Lucy automatically receives max stacks when her Edgerunner Bonds is active). Switching to another Resonator ends Edgerunner Bonds and Overlimit early.
Lucy can enhance the turret, increasing its DMG Multiplier by 250%, but its on-field duration will be lowered to 4s.

tuneBreakAttacks.name: Tune Break: Hack - Meltdown
tuneBreakAttacks.description:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Rebecca can cast Tune Break on the target.

Rebecca can inflict Hack - Shifting and respond to Hack - Interfered on targets.
Responding to Hack - Interfered: When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG and inflicts the Hack - Interfered, Rebecca triggers Hack - Meltdown on the target. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.

buffs.name: Switch Gears! - Huntress
buffs.details: Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes. - The Huntress mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%. By default, Rebecca starts in the Huntress mode.

buffs.name: Switch Gears! - Guts
buffs.details: Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes. - The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.

buffs.name: Preem Choom
buffs.details: Lucy can enhance the turret, increasing its DMG Multiplier by 250%, but its on-field duration will be lowered to 4s.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Tag, You're It!
buffs.details:
ATK is increased by 10% for 12s when A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, or when Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts is cast, stacking up to 2 times.
When a Resonator in the team inflicts Hack - Shifting, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 30 for 30s.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Tag, You're It! - Tune Break Boost
buffs.details: When a Resonator in the team inflicts Hack - Shifting, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 30 for 30s.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Left an Opening!
buffs.details:
Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress and Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts gain increased Resistance to Interruption.
When Rebecca casts Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, the ATK of all nearby Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 30s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: Try Not to Get in the Way!
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multipliers of the following skills are increased by 50%:
- Basic Attack - Huntress, Heavy Attack - Huntress, Tactical Dodge - Huntress, and Dodge Counter - Huntress
- Basic Attack - Guts, Tactical Dodge - Guts, Dodge Counter - Guts.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, Rebecca gains 3 additional stacks of Street Smarts for 12s. Upon performing Tactical Dodge - Huntress or Tactical Dodge - Guts, if Rebecca has sufficient Street Smarts stacks, 1 stack will be consumed to restore 20 STA.
Resonance Liberation BOOM! Fireworks! is immune to interruption.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Oh, Hey Choom! - All-Attribute
resonanceChains.details:
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, or Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! grants 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hot Hand regenerates twice as fast when Rebecca is out of combat.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Oh, Hey Choom! - DMG Deepen
resonanceChains.details:
When Resonators in the team inflict Hack - Shifting, they gain 15% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
Hot Hand regenerates twice as fast when Rebecca is out of combat.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: Don't Sweat Your Six!
resonanceChains.details:
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks! gain 60% DMG Multiplier increase.
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! gains 30% more explosion range.
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me! grants 120 points of Hot Hand.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 4: Got Ya Covered!
resonanceChains.details: Rebecca gains an additional 60% Stat Bonus increase from the A Girl Gets What She Wants! effect.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 5: Dreamin' on the Edge
resonanceChains.details: Rebecca gains 20% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 8s when she inflicts Hack - Shifting.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: Maybe, Just Maybe...
resonanceChains.details:
Rebecca's Basic Attack DMG Bonus from every source is increased by 40%.
During Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, Rebecca deals an additional instance of Electro DMG equal to 900% of her ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Rebecca recovers an additional 20 points of Hot Hand when she is casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts.
When Rebecca takes a fatal blow, she does not fall to the damage and instead restores fixed 2077 HP for 5 times immediately. This effect is triggered once every 10 min.
When Rebecca stays out of combat for more than 4s, she restores 120 points of Fervor. This effect is triggered once every 4s.

weaponPassives.details: Increase ATK by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%.
After the wielder inflicts Fusion Burst or Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, their Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 36%/45%/54%/63%/72% for 5s.

While this effect lasts, after Resonators in the team inflict Fusion Burst or Tune Strain - Shifting, their ATK is increased by 24%/30%/36%/42%/48% for 15s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

Mid-air Heavy Attack - Breakdown Form
Hold Normal Attack in the air to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Fusion DMG.

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Bubbles and Baits
skillAttacks.description:
Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form
Pull in nearby targets, dealing Fusion DMG.

Beckon - Breakdown Form
Pull in nearby targets, dealing Fusion DMG.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Banish - Breakdown Form.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Banish - Breakdown Form
While holding a Dark Core, replace Beckon - Breakdown Form with Banish - Breakdown Form.
Cast Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 1 to pull in nearby targets, dealing Fusion DMG. Press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill shortly after to cast Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2.
Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2 consumes all Dark Cores, dealing Fusion DMG. For each Dark Core consumed, the DMG Multiplier of the attack is increased by 150%.
The skill deals Resonance Liberation DMG.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Beckon - Breakdown Form.
Can be cast in mid-air.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Final Act
liberationAttacks.description:
Final Act - Stagecraft Form
Deal Fusion DMG.
After performing this skill, obtain Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form for 12s, then switch to Breakdown Form.

Final Act - Breakdown Form
When Conformal Charge is full, consume all Conformal Charge and Void Particle to perform this skill.
Deal Fusion DMG.
After casting this skill, obtain Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form, which lasts for 30s, and then switch to Stagecraft Form.
Can be performed in mid-air.

Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form
Increases ATK by 30%.
Obtaining this effect removes the Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect.

Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form
Grants 1 point of Void Particle per second.
Obtaining this effect removes the Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: "Flawless"
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Erosion Field
After casting Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, generate an Erosion Field, lasting for 30s. Only one Erosion Field generated by your own Resonator can exist at a time.
Erosion Field pulls in nearby targets once every 4s, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Void Particle
When in the Breakdown Form while holding Void Particle, Normal Attack consumes Void Particle on hit and grants the following effects:
- The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG and the DMG Multiplier is increased by 50%.
- Conformal Charge regenerates 100% faster.

Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst
While in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict 2 stacks of Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, and Erosion Field.
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
- When Denia is in the team, if an enemy falls to Fusion Burst DMG, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.

Resonance Mode - Tune Strain
While in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target and reset the duration of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, Erosion Field, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3 and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
- When Resonators in the team inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, this target's Off-Tune Level is increased by 50% of the max. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 300s.

Dark Core
- Denia can hold up to 3 Dark Cores.
- While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains 1 Dark Cors every 12s.
Denia obtains 1 Dark Cores upon casting Intro Skill It's Been A While! and Intro Skill Knock Knock.

Void Particle
- Denia can hold up to 100 points of Void Particle.
- While in Stagecraft Form, dealing damage through Normal Attack grants Void Particle.
- Casting Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock or Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form grants 25 points of Void Particle.

Conformal Charge
- Denia can hold up to 100 points of Conformal Charge.
- While in Breakdown Form, dealing damage through Normal Attack or Resonance Skill Beckon - Breakdown Form grants Conformal Charge.
- Casting Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2 grants 40 points of Conformal Charge.

introAttacks.name: Intro Skill: Formal Greetings
introAttacks.description:
It's Been A While!
Available in Stagecraft Form, dealing Fusion DMG.
Press Normal Attack after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4.

Knock Knock
Available in Breakdown Form, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting this skill grants Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form for 12s.

outroAttacks.name: Outro Skill: Unfinished Lies
outroAttacks.description:
When in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Fusion Burst DMG against targets near the active Resonator in the team is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends early when Denia switches modes.

When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, the incoming Resonator has their All DMG Amplified by 15% for 16s.
After this Resonator under this effect inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, they gain 40% DMG Amplification instead.
This effect ends early when this Resonator is switched out or when Denia switches modes.

tuneBreakAttacks.name: Tune Break: Shattered Hours
tuneBreakAttacks.description:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Denia can cast Tune Break on the target.

When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia gains the following effects:
- Denia can inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target.
- Denia can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
When responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, each point of Denia's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Denia is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.

buffs.name: Dark Core
buffs.details:
- Denia can hold Dark Cores.
- While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains 1 Dark Core every 12s.
- Denia obtains 1 Dark Core upon casting Intro Skill It's Been A While! and Intro Skill Knock Knock.
- Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2 consumes all Dark Cores, dealing Fusion DMG. For each Dark Core consumed, the DMG Multiplier of the attack is increased by 150%.

buffs.name: Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form
buffs.details:
Increases ATK by 30%.
Obtaining this effect removes the Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect.

buffs.name: Void Particle
buffs.details:
When in the Breakdown Form while holding Void Particle, Normal Attack consumes Void Particle on hit and grants the following effects:
- The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG and the DMG Multiplier is increased by 50%.
- Conformal Charge regenerates 100% faster.

buffs.name: Inherent Skil: Vestiges of Falsehood
buffs.details: When Denia engages in combat in Stagecraft Form: restore Dark Cores to 2 if she has fewer than 2; restore Void Particle to 20 points if she has fewer than 20. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Etched Colors
buffs.details:
While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains the following effects based on her current Resonance Mode:
- Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst: All Resonators in the team gain 30% Fusion DMG Bonus.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Etched Colors
buffs.details:
While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains the following effects based on her current Resonance Mode:
- Resonance Mode - Tune Strain: All Resonators in the team gain 10 Tune Break Boost. When a Resonator in the team has an Off-Tune Buildup Rate over 100%, every 10% that runs over increases the Resonator's Tune Break Boost by 8, up to 40.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: Etched Colors - Off-Tune Buildup Rate
buffs.details:
While in the Entropy Shift states, Denia obtains the following effects based on her current Resonance Mode:
- Resonance Mode - Tune Strain: All Resonators in the team gain 10 Tune Break Boost. When a Resonator in the team has an Off-Tune Buildup Rate over 100%, every 10% that runs over increases the Resonator's Tune Break Boost by 8, up to 40.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: Silent Glows in a Dimlit Dream
resonanceChains.details:
Crit. DMG is increased by 30%.

When performing Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form, or Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Denia becomes immune to interruption.

When Denia enters combat in Stagecraft Form, she obtains the Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect for 30s.
When Denia enters combat in Breakdown Form, she obtains the Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect for 12s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Tossed in the Tides of Reality
resonanceChains.details: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form is increased by 40%.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Tossed in the Tides of Reality
resonanceChains.details: When Denia is in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, after a Resonator in the team inflicts Fusion Burst on the target, they gain 50% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Tossed in the Tides of Reality (Resist Ignore)
resonanceChains.details:
After Fusion Burst is triggered on enemies near the active Resonator in the team, Denia gains 1 stack of Degenerate Voidmatter for 15s, up to 10 stacks. Each stack of Degenerate Voidmatter causes Denia to ignore 1% of the target's Fusion RES.
This effect ends when Denia switches modes.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: Tossed in the Tides of Reality
resonanceChains.details:
When Denia is in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, her Forte Circuit effect is enhanced: After a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 20 for 15s, and the target's Off-Tune Level is increased by 100% of the max. This effect can only be triggered once per 300s on the same target.
This effect ends when Denia switches forms.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: Through Dark and Wind, the Erlking Follows
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form is increased by 80%.

Denia now holds up to 5 Dark Cores. While in Entropy Shift, the shortest interval at which she can obtain Dark Core is reduced to 6s.
The Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect is enhanced and now grants 4 points of Void Particle per second.
The Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect is enhanced: Casting Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy.

Denia's Inherent Skill Vestiges of Falsehood is enhanced:
Upon entering combat, Dark Core and Void Particle are restored to the max. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

When the number of Dark Cores reaches the limit, casting Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4 or Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form consumes all Dark Cores and increases the DMG Multiplier of this skill by 1200%. The DMG dealt is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

resonanceChains.details: The attack interval of Erosion Field is reduced to 3s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 5: If Lies Patch Up a Heart
resonanceChains.details: The DMG of Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form is increased by 100%.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: May You Find Your Sun in the Silence
resonanceChains.details: While in Entropy Shift states, gain 60% ATK increase and 60% Fusion DMG Bonus.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: May You Find Your Sun in the Silence
resonanceChains.details: While Denia is in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, after Erosion Field deals damage, trigger Fusion Burst on the target based on its max limit. The Fusion Burst DMG triggered gains a 200% DMG Multiplier increase against the main target and does not remove the Fusion Burst stacks on the targets hit. The effect can be triggered on the same target up to 1 time. When the target is damaged by Resonance Liberation Final Act: Breakdown Form, the effect's trigger count is reset. The trigger count can be reset for the same target once every 2s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: May You Find Your Sun in the Silence
resonanceChains.details: While Denia is in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, when Resonators in the team deal Tune Break DMG to Mistuned enemies in Tune Strain - Shifting, they additionally inflict 1 stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 3s.

scoringPreset.startState: Resource availability assumed by the pinned upstream preset. Level 90, S0, signature R1, permanent passives only; no team buffs. This is a damage benchmark, not an automatic combat simulation.

basicAttacks.name: Normal Attack: One, Two, Three
basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Enter Decipher state for 5s after casting Basic Attack Stage 4. This effect ends early if Sigrika is switched off the field.
When Sigrika has at least 50 points of Full Stop, her Basic Attack cycle starts from Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Elucidated
In the Decipher state, press Normal Attack on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Elucidated, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Plunging Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Decipher
In the Decipher state, press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Decipher to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Mid-air Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge in mid-air to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Mid-air Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Royan Close Quarters Combat
skillAttacks.description:
BOOMY BOOM!
Attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting BOOMY BOOM! to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

BIG BOOMY BOOM!
While in the Decipher state, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast BIG BOOMY BOOM!, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Soliskin to the Aid
While in the Decipher state, with at least 50 points of Full Stop, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast Soliskin to the Aid, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Where Trust Leads Me!
liberationAttacks.description:
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG). Gain Divergent for 20s.

Divergent
The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the opposite type and removes Divergent. When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority. When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Divergent doesn't take effect.

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: Within Infinity's Embrace
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes
Hold Normal Attack to consume two Runes and cast Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, dealing Aero DMG. Based on the types of the Runes consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming Rune: Trust and Rune: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Outburst.
- When consuming two Runes: Trust, this skill gains the effect of Runic Chain Whip.
- When consuming two Runes: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Soliskin.
When consuming Runes, if Sigrika holds at least 30 points of Soliskin Vitality, consume 30 points to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin by 50%. Obtain a stack of Innate Gift?.
When consuming Runes, if Soliskin Vitality is lower than 30 points, consume all Soliskin Vitality. Every 10 points of Soliskin Vitality consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes deals Echo Skill DMG.

Runic Outburst
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Chain Whip
Stagnate nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Soliskin
Pull in nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name
When Full Stop reaches 100 points, if Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is not on Cooldown, press Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Hold Resonance Skill to consume all Full Stop to cast Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Innate Gift?
Sigrika can hold up to 2 stacks of Innate Gift?. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.

Rune
Sigrika holds up to 4 Runes. Without Full Stop, Sigrika can only hold up to 2 Runes. When Sigrika gains a new Rune at max capacity, the existing Runes shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost Rune. With at least 50 points of Full Stop, Sigrika can hold 2 additional Runes.
Hitting a target with Basic Attack - Elucidated or Dodge Counter - Decipher grants one Rune: Trust.
Hitting a target with Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid grants one Rune: Answer.

Full Stop
After casting Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, gain 50 points of Full Stop.

Soliskin Vitality
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 points of Soliskin Vitality, up to 60 points. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting Outro Skill - In This Very Moment resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.

introAttacks.name: Intro Skill: Solsworn Etymology
introAttacks.description:
Deal Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Intro Skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

outroAttacks.name: Outro Skill: In This Very Moment
outroAttacks.description:
Attack the target, deal Aero DMG equal to 795% of Sigrika's ATK. Gain 2 stacks of Encapsulated for 30s.

Encapsulated
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skills, Stagnate the target and consume 1 stacks of Encapsulated. Encapsulated stacks up to 2 times. All stacks of Encapsulated are removed when Sigrika is removed from the lineup.

tuneBreakAttacks.name: Tune Break
tuneBreakAttacks.description:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Sigrika can cast Tune Break on the target.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Tune Break to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

buffs.name: Blessing Of Runes
buffs.details: For every 1% of Sigrika's Energy Regen over 125%, Sigrika gains 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for up to 50%.

buffs.name: Schemata of Runes
buffs.details: When consuming Runes, if Sigrika holds at least 30 points of Soliskin Vitality, consume 30 points to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin by 50%

buffs.name: Soliskin Vitality
buffs.details: Every 10 points of Soliskin Vitality consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.

buffs.name: Innate Gift?
buffs.details:
Sigrika can hold up to 2 stacks of Innate Gift?. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: True Names Invoked
buffs.details:
Casting Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology grants Convergent for 20s.

Convergent
The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent.
When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop<, Convergent doesn't take effect.

buffs.name: Inherent Skill: True Names Aligned
buffs.details:
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
This effect resets upon a lineup change.

Blessing of Runes
Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks. Sigrika gains an additional 30% increase in Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 1: The Gleam Meant for Radiance
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Elucidated, Dodge Counter - Decipher, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid are increased by 70%.
Sigrika becomes immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack - Elucidated, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid.
Encapsulated now stacks up to 3 times. After casting Outro Skill In This Very Moment, Sigrika obtains 1 additional stacks.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 2: The Bitterness Steeped in Hope
resonanceChains.details:
The DMG Multiplier of Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is increased by 120%.
When not in combat for over 4s, Sigrika gains Divergent. This effect is active for up to 1 time every 4s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 3: I Flee, Yet I Seek
resonanceChains.details:
Innate Gift? now stacks up to 4 times and is no longer removed after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.
All Innate Gift? stacks are removed every 30s that Sigrika stays out of combat.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 4: I Lose, Yet I Gain
resonanceChains.details: When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Resonators in the team gain an 20% ATK increase for 20s.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 5: Until Submerged by the Dark
resonanceChains.details: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Where Trust Leads Me! is increased by 30%.

resonanceChains.name: Sequence Node 6: True Names Resurfaced, Rising in Light
resonanceChains.details:
Targets take 30% more DMG from Sigrika.
Innate Gift? gains following effects:
- Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 15% DMG Amplification, up to 60%.
- Each stack causes Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name to ignore 7.5% of the target's DEF when dealing damage, up to 30%.

weaponPassives.details: Grants 12%/15%/18%/21%/24% All-Attribute DMG Bonus.
When Havoc Bane is applied, Heavy Attack DMG is Amplified by 36%/45%/54%/63%/72% for 8s.
When Havoc Bane is applied, Heavy Attack DMG ignores 12%/15%/18%/21%/24% of the target's DEF, for 8s

basicAttacks.name: Normal Attack: Succor and Smite
basicAttacks.description:
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance
Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen of Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance is increased by 20%.
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance
Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen of Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance is increased by 20%.
Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

skillAttacks.name: Resonance Skill: Feather's Edge
skillAttacks.description:
Sword Stance Switch
While in Azure Sword Stance, press Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

While in Feather Sword Stance, press Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

Sword Stance Switch: Azure
Pressing Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

Sword Stance Switch: Feather
Pressing Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance to swtich to Feather Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

liberationAttacks.name: Resonance Liberation: Hush of a Thousand Voices
liberationAttacks.description:
Hush of a Thousand Voices
Consume all Melody to deal Havoc DMG and restore 1 Azure Plume. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Upon casting this skill, obtain Voice upon Voice. When casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, summon Shadow of Xuanling to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Voice upon Voice cannot stack. Once Shadow of Xuanling is summoned, the Voice upon Voice state is removed.

attacks.label: Hush of a Thousand Voices DMG

forteCircuitAttacks.name: Forte Circuit: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
forteCircuitAttacks.description:
Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure
Yangyang: Xuanling is in Azure Sword Stance. When Melody is depleted while in Feather Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure.
Press Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure hits the target, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather
When Melody is depleted while in Azure Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather.
Press Resonance Skill switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, switching to Feather Sword Stance and dealing Havoc DMG, restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather hits, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Azure Sword Stance, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, gain Bated Breath: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance increases by 160%. When Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance ends, Bated Breath is removed. Bated Breath can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance applies 2 stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets it hits.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, dealing Havoc DMG. After it hits a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast.
When casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, gain Streaming Storm, which lasts 15s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of the next Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by 160%. Streaming Storm is removed when Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 ends. Streaming Storm can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance applies 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets it hits.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance and airborne, Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall. Switching to another Resonator automatically casts Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall.
Press or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, dealing Havoc DMG. Casting Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall enters Hark the Wind for 12s.

Hark the Wind
While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, consuming STA to perform up to 3 stages of attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During Hark the Wind, a Dodge Counter counts towards the Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle.

Feathered Oath
When nearby Resonators in the team apply Havoc Bane to a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Feathered Oath for 4s. Feathered Oath can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by 25%, up to 150%.

Refrain
Before Yangyang: Xuanling's Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, or Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of Havoc Bane on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

Melody
Melody has a maximum of 100 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather restores 100 Melody.
Casting Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices consumes all Melody.
Normal Attacks consumes Melody upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Melody.

Azure Plume
Azure Plume has a maximum of 2 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, or Intro Skill - Skybound Feather restores 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Azure Plume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices restores 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Azure Plume.
Casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consumes all Azure Plume.
